latest_release.name: v4.5.0
latest_release.body:
Omarchy 4.5 (aka Quattro RS!) is the first big feature release since [Quattro](https://github.com/omacom/omarchy/releases/tag/v4.0.0), and it’s a whopper: over 740 pull requests merged from more than 180 contributors in just twelve weeks. It now offers a traditional desktop mode next to the tiling default. You can install it natively on a M1/M2/M3/Neo MacBooks. And it speaks 50 languages. And a gazillion other features, fixes, and improvements.

Release notes: https://omarchy.org/news/2026/11/omarchy-4-5/
